question: Former minister of the state and former president of BJP alliance partner IPFT _______ received the Padma Shri award (posthumously) in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Chandra Debbarma**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narendra Chandra Debbarma**, the former minister of the state and former president of BJP alliance partner IPFT, was posthumously awarded the Padma Shri in 2023.
 
• The Padma Shri is one of the highest civilian awards in India, recognizing distinguished contributions in various fields such as arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Narendra Chandra Debbarma played a significant role in Tripura's political landscape and was known for his dedication to the development of the state.
 
• The award was conferred posthumously, honoring his lifelong commitment and service to the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Padma Shri award is part of the Padma Awards, which also include the Padma Vibhushan and Padma Bhushan. These awards are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• The selection process for the Padma Awards involves recommendations from state governments, union territories, ministries, and individuals, which are then reviewed by a committee constituted by the Prime Minister of India.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Shri are recognized for their distinguished service in their respective fields, contributing to the growth and development of the country.
 
• Narendra Chandra Debbarma's contributions to the political and social development of Tripura were widely acknowledged and celebrated through this prestigious award.
